sentences.text: Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo, airport included.
It began in February in a limited sixty square mile area.
In April, flood water swept an empty Waymo into Salado Creek.
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
Waymo then filed a recall for nearly thirty eight hundred cars.
The recall says a car may slow, then drive into standing water.
The federal record says the remedy is still under development.
As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits.
All affected cars had the update by April twentieth.
So the airport ride is open.
The record still lists the flood remedy as under development.
